title: Everything from the site's Mess Machine
thisBuild: FX button on the Pads tab: hold Stutter, Echo throw, Crush, Tape stop, Gate, Dirt, Ring mod, Octave down or Reverse while you play, plus the filter pad (low or high pass).
Strip button: the keys strip under the pads, with chords.
Sounds tab, Your Workbench jar: import sounds (WAV, MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC), record from the mic, resample a loop into one sound.

Doctor's table: zoom to the trim, snap to zero, loop the trim, re-pitch to fit 1 beat to 4 bars, chop to pads (equal, by hits, tap the wave, or tap while it plays), save the edit as a new sound, share it as a WAV.
Star sounds; the Starred jar keeps them together.
On the site, Save as file and Open a file move a mess between the site and the app.
Faster: tapping pads no longer rebuilds the whole screen.
watch: Hold Stutter and Tape stop while a loop plays.
Record a mic take, then chop it to pads with Auto.
If anything feels slow, send a Tuning note right away so the speed numbers go with it.
limits: Creature cards and the Ring are not in the app yet.
Jams and duels need claude.ai's shared rooms, so they stay on the site.
It stops playing a while after you leave the app.
